name: Astroneer
description: Aerospace sandbox exploration and base building. Windows dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

variables.label: Game port (UDP)
variables.description: Must match the Port setting in Astro/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Engine.ini (default 8777).

variables.label: Owner Steam name
variables.description: Must also be set as OwnerName in AstroServerSettings.ini — the owner claims the server in-game.

notes: After the first run, edit Astro/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/AstroServerSettings.ini: set OwnerName (Steam profile name), PublicIP (the server's public IPv4) and ServerName; set the port under [URL] in Engine.ini. Players join via IP:port from the in-game co-op menu. The server binary is Windows-only.
